title: Nordic DiGRA 2027
institution: University of Bergen, Center for Digital Narrative
about: Call for papers for Nordic DiGRA 2027, themed Game Culture Narratives, held June 9-11, 2027 at the University of Bergen, Norway. Full papers (5,000-7,000 words), extended abstracts and workshop proposals are due January 24, 2027.
card_alt: Card for the Nordic DiGRA 2027 call for papers at the University of Bergen, Center for Digital Narrative in Bergen, Norway, submission deadline 24 Jan 2027. The background photo shows the lit wooden houses of the Bryggen waterfront in Bergen on a snowy winter evening.
